faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes SL63 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. From 2006 to 2021 (R230 and R231 generations), the SL63 AMG used the M157 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8. From 2021 onwards (R232), it switched to the M177 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes SL63 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my SL63 AMG?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M157 or the M177 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M157 SL63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace valve seals, coolant components, timing chains and bearings as standard on every M157 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M177 SL63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The M177 shares the same established AMG V8 wear pattern — valve seal and coolant system wear — and we service it to the same standard as the M157.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used SL63 AMG engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my SL63 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an SL63 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most SL63 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
